title: Algorithmic Medicine: Accountability, Bias and Compassion

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: In some studies, AI systems have matched or exceeded human readers in detecting melanomas, breast cancer on mammograms and some CT abnormalities. However, algorithmic medicine creates complex legal quandaries: who is liable when an AI diagnostic system misdiagnoses a malignancy?

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: Many bioethicists stress that diagnosis is only one part of healing; medical care also involves *empátia* and telling hard truths with compassion, which a neural network does not do.
